notes: The built-in LED on D13 needs no extra parts. The graph models the optional external LED circuit, as the task asks.

Breadboard holes are read from the image. The image shows rows f-j on the lower half of the top section, so I used bank 'b' for them, with row f next to the centre gap. Column numbers are approximate.

The orange wire ends in column 3, row f. The resistor spans columns 3 to 6 in row h. The LED anode (long, bent leg) is in column 6 and the cathode is in column 8. The black wire goes from the Uno GND pin next to pin 13 to column 8, row g.
Column 6 and column 8 are separate strips, so the resistor to LED anode and the LED cathode to GND connections stay distinct.
The Uno has three GND ports, GND.1 to GND.3. I assumed the GND pin beside AREF and pin 13 is GND.1.
The schematic and text give a 220 ohm resistor from D13 to the LED anode, and the LED cathode to GND.
